 15 Marvel Movies And Series To Watch Before Avengers: Doomsday: The Ultimate Watchlist
 With Avengers: Doomsday scheduled to hit Indian theatres on December 17, 2026, Marvel fans have plenty of stories to catch up on before Doctor Doom takes centre stage. From the original X-Men films and Avengers adventures to multiverse-focused movies and the latest MCU releases, here are 15 essential titles to add to your watchlist.
 Parthana Bora 
 16 Nov 2026 
 18:03
 IST Follow Us
 New Update The Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) is preparing for another major crossover with Avengers: Doomsday, bringing together superheroes, mutants and characters from different universes. With Doctor Doom emerging as the central threat, several familiar faces are expected to return, making the upcoming film one of Marvel's most anticipated releases.
 Scheduled to release in Indian theatres on December 17, 2026, the film will connect several storylines developed across previous Marvel movies and series. If you are wondering which titles to revisit before watching the next Avengers instalment, here is a complete guide to 15 movies and series that could help you understand the story. 
 15 Marvel Movies And Series To Watch Before Avengers: Doomsday 
 From the original X-Men universe to the introduction of the Fantastic Four, these films and series explore characters and storylines connected to the upcoming Marvel blockbuster. 
 1. Captain America: The First Avenger 
 Before Steve Rogers returns to the Marvel universe, it is worth revisiting where his journey began. Captain America: The First Avenger introduces Steve Rogers, Peggy Carter and Bucky Barnes.
 The film follows Steve's transformation into Captain America during World War II and establishes relationships that remain important to his character. With Steve and Peggy expected to return in Avengers: Doomsday, the film offers important background to their story. It also introduces Bucky, who is now associated with the Thunderbolts, also known as the New Avengers.
 2. X-Men And X2 
 The original X-Men films are important starting points for understanding the return of mutants to the Marvel universe. The first film, released in 2000, introduced audiences to Professor Charles Xavier, Magneto, Cyclops and other mutants with extraordinary abilities.
 Its sequel, X2, further developed their stories and introduced characters such as Nightcrawler. With Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen and James Marsden expected to reprise their roles as Professor X, Magneto and Cyclops in Avengers: Doomsday, revisiting these films will help fans reconnect with the characters.
 3. The Avengers 
 The 2012 blockbuster The Avengers brought several of Marvel's biggest superheroes together for the first time. Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye unite to stop Loki's invasion of Earth.
 The film remains an important chapter in the MCU, particularly with Thor, Hulk, Captain America and Loki expected to return in Avengers: Doomsday. It also establishes the team dynamics that shaped subsequent Avengers films.
 4. Avengers: Infinity War 
 Avengers: Infinity War is one of the most significant films in the MCU timeline. The story follows Earth's mightiest heroes as they attempt to stop Thanos from collecting all six Infinity Stones and wiping out half of the universe's population.
 The film brings together superheroes from different corners of the MCU and sets up the events that follow in Avengers: Endgame. Its large-scale conflict and interconnected character stories make it an important watch before the next Avengers instalment.
 5. Avengers: Endgame (Encore) 
 No Avengers watchlist is complete without Avengers: Endgame. The film concludes the original Avengers storyline, featuring the superheroes' final battle against Thanos and marking the end of Tony Stark's journey as Iron Man.
 It also shows Steve Rogers returning to Peggy Carter and eventually passing the Captain America shield to Sam Wilson. These developments are particularly relevant as the MCU prepares to bring back Steve Rogers.
 The Encore version is also worth watching, as it reportedly features additional scenes connected to Avengers: Doomsday.
 6. Loki (Seasons 1 And 2) 
 The two seasons of Loki explore the complexities of time travel, alternate timelines and the multiverse. Following the events of Avengers: Endgame, Loki finds himself caught up in the activities of the Time Variance Authority (TVA).
 Across both seasons, his journey takes an unexpected turn as he discovers a much bigger purpose connected to the existence of different timelines. With Tom Hiddleston returning as Loki in Avengers: Doomsday, the series offers important context about his evolution and connection to the multiverse.
 7. Shang-Chi And The Legend Of The Ten Rings 
 Introduced after the events of Avengers: Endgame, Shang-Chi quickly became an important addition to the MCU. The film follows his return to his family and his confrontation with his father, Wenwu, while uncovering the mystery surrounding the powerful Ten Rings.
 With Shang-Chi expected to be part of the superhero alliance against Doctor Doom, revisiting his introduction will help audiences understand his background and abilities.
 8. Spider-Man: No Way Home 
 Spider-Man: No Way Home takes the MCU's multiverse storyline to another level. After a spell by Doctor Strange goes wrong, Peter Parker finds himself facing villains from different universes.
 The film also brings together multiple versions of Spider-Man, making it one of the most significant multiverse-focused entries in the franchise. Although Spider-Man's involvement in Avengers: Doomsday remains unclear, the film provides useful background on how different universes can collide.
 9. Doctor Strange In The Multiverse Of Madness 
 As its title suggests, Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness takes viewers deeper into the mysteries of alternate realities. The film follows Doctor Strange as he encounters different versions of himself and attempts to protect America Chavez, who possesses the ability to travel between universes.
 It also features a major confrontation between Doctor Strange and Wanda Maximoff. With the multiverse expected to play a central role in Avengers: Doomsday, this film is an important addition to the watchlist.
 10. Black Panther: Wakanda Forever 
 Black Panther: Wakanda Forever explores the aftermath of T'Challa's death and introduces audiences to the next chapter of Wakanda's story. The film follows Shuri as she takes on greater responsibilities while the kingdom faces new threats.
 With Wakanda's superheroes expected to play a role in the upcoming battle against Doctor Doom, the film provides useful context about the kingdom, its leadership and its technological capabilities.
 11. Deadpool & Wolverine 
 The arrival of Deadpool & Wolverine marked a significant moment for Marvel fans, bringing two popular characters together while expanding the multiverse storyline.
 The film also connects the X-Men universe with the MCU and features several appearances that make it particularly relevant to the upcoming Avengers film. Channing Tatum's appearance as Gambit is another major highlight, especially with the character expected to return in Avengers: Doomsday.
 12. Captain America: Brave New World 
 Following Steve Rogers' decision to pass on the shield, Captain America: Brave New World places Sam Wilson at the centre of the story as the new Captain America.
 The film explores his responsibilities as a superhero and his involvement in a larger political conflict. Since Sam is expected to be among the key characters in Avengers: Doomsday, watching this instalment will help audiences understand his position in the current MCU.
 13. Thunderbolts* 
 Thunderbolts introduces a team of unconventional superheroes and former outsiders who find themselves working together under unexpected circumstances.
 The film brings together characters including Yelena Belova, Bucky Barnes, Red Guardian, Ghost and John Walker. Its ending and post-credit sequence also establish an important connection with the Fantastic Four, making it a significant watch before Avengers: Doomsday.
 14. The Fantastic Four: First Steps 
 The introduction of the Fantastic Four is another major development leading into Avengers: Doomsday. The Fantastic Four: First Steps reintroduces Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm and Ben Grimm, played by a new cast.
 The film explores the team's origins and their place in a different universe. Their connection to Doctor Doom makes this instalment particularly important. Its post-credit sequence also provides an early glimpse of Doom, setting up his arrival in the larger MCU storyline.
 15. VisionQuest 
 The upcoming series VisionQuest follows Vision as he attempts to reconnect with his children after losing Wanda Maximoff. The story adds another chapter to the complicated history of the Maximoff family.
 Its reported connection to Doctor Doom and Wanda's return makes it particularly relevant to the upcoming film. As the MCU continues to bring together characters and storylines from different phases, VisionQuest could provide another important piece of the puzzle before Avengers: Doomsday.
 Conclusion 
 With Avengers: Doomsday bringing together superheroes, mutants and characters from different corners of the Marvel universe, catching up on these 15 titles can help fans understand the story leading up to the blockbuster.
 From the original Avengers and the X-Men to the Fantastic Four and the evolving multiverse, each entry offers a glimpse into the characters and events shaping the MCU's next major chapter.
 With the film scheduled to release in Indian theatres on December 17, 2026, Marvel fans still have time to revisit these stories and prepare for Doctor Doom's arrival on the big screen.
